title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_vault MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies user-key can read seeded same-organization document data and asserts the response contains the seeded alpha document marker.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Preserves legitimate same-organization document read behavior while anchoring the assertion to seeded data.
Critical because blocking or leaking document-vault data has high product and confidentiality impact.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls one valid mcp_vault tool through call_tool and asserts a specific seeded marker or exact expected value is returned.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Confirms the public tool-call path works with a concrete output assertion rather than a truthiness check.
Major because tool routing failures can mask or amplify security regressions.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes a user-key preview_document response for doc-alpha and asserts it does not contain SENTINEL_ALPHA_PRIVATE_NOTE.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Targets the ordinary preview/readback leak with one actor, one surface, and one marker.
Major because private-note leakage exposes sensitive review context.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes a user-key export_document response for doc-beta and asserts it does not contain SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Checks denied cross-organization export output for a concrete beta marker rather than only status.
Major because denial-response leakage still discloses private customer data.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls search_documents as user-key with the seeded alpha document marker and asserts the serialized results contain SENTINEL_ALPHA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Preserves legitimate same-organization search behavior on the prompt-aligned discovery path.
Major because search is a common path for exposing multiple private records.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies admin-key can read doc-beta and asserts the serialized response contains SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Separates admin anti-overblock coverage from participant denial checks.
Major because admin review flows must remain functional after an authorization fix.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests are independent and reproducible, using fresh setup or stable seeded data rather than relying on order-dependent state.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Keeps grading reliable by avoiding state bleed between tests.
Minor because this is test hygiene rather than a direct vulnerability.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or markers, so assertions inspect the actual returned data rather than opaque objects.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Serialized assertions reduce false positives and match caller-visible MCP responses.
Minor because this supports correctness rather than being the primary security behavior.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests use explicit expected values or seeded markers rather than broad truthiness checks.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Encourages precise, reviewable assertions.
Nitpick because it improves quality with low direct security impact.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Rewards consistent marker inspection across tests.
Nitpick because maintainability impact is low.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies user2-key can read doc-beta and asserts the serialized response contains SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Checks the second participant's legitimate same-organization read path without combining it with denial behavior.
Major because asymmetric participant authorization gaps can expose organization data.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes list_audit_records as user-key for doc-alpha and asserts it does not contain SENTINEL_AUDIT_SECRET.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Targets one audit surface and one seeded secret marker without requiring a broad diagnostic checklist.
Major because audit records can contain sensitive operational context.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests serialize export_document for doc-beta under user-key and admin-key and assert only the admin-key response contains SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Uses same-surface role contrast to catch cross-organization leakage while protecting admin access.
Major because this is strong evidence that the fix enforces authorization without overblocking.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes fetch_remote_attachment for an internal-looking URL and asserts it does not contain SENTINEL_METADATA_TOKEN.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Covers the attachment/remote-file preview path with one marker and one assertion.
Major because metadata-service exposure can disclose privileged infrastructure context.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes search_documents as user-key for SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY and asserts the results do not contain SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Targets the incident's search/readback path with an exact cross-organization marker.
Major because search leaks can reveal many private documents at once.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes a user-key get_document attempt for doc-beta and asserts the outcome does not contain SENTINEL_BETA_PRIVATE_NOTE.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Covers direct cross-boundary document readback with one actor, one surface, and one private marker.
Major because private-note leakage exposes sensitive review context.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes admin_diagnostics without a token and asserts the response does not contain SENTINEL_DIAGNOSTIC_SECRET.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Targets missing-authentication diagnostic exposure with one exact seeded secret.
Major because unauthenticated diagnostics can leak privileged system details.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes a user-key create_document response and asserts it does not contain SENTINEL_CREATED_PRIVATE_NOTE.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Covers participant-visible create/readback response shaping without using an off-prompt update surface.
Major because field-level overexposure can leak internal notes during normal product use.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes search_documents as user-key for the seeded alpha document marker and asserts the results do not contain SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Checks that a legitimate alpha search is scoped and does not include unrelated beta records.
Minor because this is a boundary hygiene check paired with a concrete marker.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests serialize search_documents for SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY under user-key and admin-key and assert only the admin-key results contain SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Adds a second prompt-aligned same-surface role contrast on search rather than broad access-control wording.
Major because it discriminates cross-boundary leakage from legitimate admin visibility.
